question.text:
In how many of the following all bond lengths are not equal?
CO3-2,O3,BF3,P4white,PCl,SF4,CIF3,XeF2,XeF4,ClF4+

solution.text: In <math><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><msub><mrow><mtext>PCl</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mtext>SF</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mtext>ClF</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mtext>CIF</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> all bond lengths are not equal.
